none: PAS WILT-EE9F62: Roman bow and fan tail brooch
contea di ritrovamento: Wiltshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete copper alloy Roman (AD 50-200) tinned 'bow-and-fantail' brooch missing the bow, head, and pin. The curl of the catch plate remains. The brooch measures 23.21 mm in length, 18.64 mm wide, and weighs 2.84 grams. The fantail, almost the only surviving part of the brooch, is triangular and connects at its upper point to the bow, of which only a fragment survives. The engraved decoration…
